name: Harpy Lieutenants
summary: In the northern Barrens, Darsok Swiftdagger sends Horde champions against the Witchwing coven. In the Dry Hills, they target the flock’s officers to break its command.

sections.title: Targeting the Officers
sections.body: After the first clashes with Witchwing raiders, Darsok Swiftdagger turns the Horde’s attack toward the harpies in the Dry Hills. Scouts seek out the Witchwing Slayers who lead the flock. These officers keep lesser harpies in line and direct raids on Horde supply paths. Their deaths are vital to securing the Barrens’ northern approaches.

sections.title: Tokens of Rank
sections.body: Witchwing Slayers rule through strength, and the most vicious among them wear ornate rings to mark their authority in the matriarchy. Taking the rings proves the lieutenants are dead and disrupts the roost’s coordination. It also warns the coven that attacks on Horde territory will meet decisive retribution.

sections.title: A Path to the Matriarch
sections.body: The Witchwing officers’ deaths leave the lower flock in disarray. Removing the roost’s field commanders also weakens the perimeter around the heights of the Dry Hills. That opens a path toward the inner sanctum of the matriarch, Serena Bloodfeather.

faq.q: Where do I find the harpy lieutenants?
faq.answer: Find the harpy lieutenants in the Dry Hills, northwest of the Crossroads in the far north of the Barrens. Witchwing Slayers patrol the hills.

faq.q: How are these lieutenants identified among the flock?
faq.answer: Witchwing Slayers lead the Witchwing coven. Their distinctive harpy rings mark their authority over lesser scouts and raiders.
Darsok Swiftdagger issues the bounty. He is an orc scout and coordinator stationed at the Crossroads in the Barrens, and assigns the contract to protect Horde interests and punish harpy incursions.

faq.q: Why does the Horde want to kill the lieutenants instead of just regular harpies?
faq.answer: The lieutenants direct lesser harpies and organize predatory strikes. Killing them breaks the matriarchy’s leadership and leaves the flock disorganized and vulnerable.

faq.q: What comes after eliminating the lieutenants?
faq.answer: After the lieutenants are slain, Darsok Swiftdagger directs champions to hunt Serena Bloodfeather, the flock’s matriarch, atop the highest bluffs of the Dry Hills.

faq.q: Why are the Witchwing harpies a threat to the Crossroads?
faq.answer: The Witchwing coven infests the northern passes of the Barrens. Its harpies prey on travelers, supply caravans, and patrols traveling between the Crossroads, Durotar, and Ashenvale.

angles.text: Securing the northern corridors of the Barrens helps keep communication open between Durotar, Mulgore, and the Ashenvale logging camps.
As a rogue, you know the value of striking high-value officers with precision. Darsok Swiftdagger relies on these assassinations instead of costly open warfare.
